name: text_values
sr: SELECT id, array_map(x -> hex(x), items) FROM {table} ORDER BY id
pg: SELECT id, CASE WHEN items IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE array_to_json(ARRAY(SELECT upper(encode(convert_to(v, 'UTF8'), 'hex')) FROM unnest(items) WITH ORDINALITY u(v,n) ORDER BY n))::text END FROM p ORDER BY id

name: varchar_values
sr: SELECT id, array_map(x -> hex(x), labels) FROM {table} ORDER BY id
pg: SELECT id, CASE WHEN labels IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE array_to_json(ARRAY(SELECT upper(encode(convert_to(v, 'UTF8'), 'hex')) FROM unnest(labels) WITH ORDINALITY u(v,n) ORDER BY n))::text END FROM p ORDER BY id

name: array_lengths
sr: SELECT id, array_length(items), array_length(labels) FROM {table} ORDER BY id
pg: SELECT id, cardinality(items), cardinality(labels) FROM p ORDER BY id

name: group_arrays
sr: SELECT array_map(x -> hex(x), items), COUNT(*) n FROM {table} WHERE id IN (1,6,7,8) GROUP BY items
pg: SELECT CASE WHEN items IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE array_to_json(ARRAY(SELECT upper(encode(convert_to(v, 'UTF8'), 'hex')) FROM unnest(items) WITH ORDINALITY u(v,n) ORDER BY n))::text END, COUNT(*) n FROM p WHERE id IN (1,6,7,8) GROUP BY items

name: distinct_arrays

pg: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN items IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE array_to_json(ARRAY(SELECT upper(encode(convert_to(v, 'UTF8'), 'hex')) FROM unnest(items) WITH ORDINALITY u(v,n) ORDER BY n))::text END FROM p WHERE id IN (1,6,7,8)

name: count_distinct_arrays

pg: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT items) FROM p WHERE id IN (1,6,7,8)

name: array_equal_join
sr: SELECT a.id, b.id FROM {table} a JOIN {table} b ON a.items = b.items WHERE a.id = 1 AND b.id IN (6,7,8) ORDER BY a.id,b.id
pg: SELECT a.id, b.id FROM p a JOIN p b ON a.items = b.items WHERE a.id = 1 AND b.id IN (6,7,8) ORDER BY a.id,b.id

name: scalar_join_array_output
sr: SELECT a.id, array_map(x -> hex(x), b.items) FROM {table} a JOIN {table} b ON a.id = b.id WHERE a.id < 10 ORDER BY a.id
pg: SELECT a.id, CASE WHEN b.items IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE array_to_json(ARRAY(SELECT upper(encode(convert_to(v, 'UTF8'), 'hex')) FROM unnest(b.items) WITH ORDINALITY u(v,n) ORDER BY n))::text END FROM p a JOIN p b ON a.id = b.id WHERE a.id < 10 ORDER BY a.id

pg: SELECT CASE WHEN items IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE array_to_json(ARRAY(SELECT upper(encode(convert_to(v, 'UTF8'), 'hex')) FROM unnest(items) WITH ORDINALITY u(v,n) ORDER BY n))::text END FROM p WHERE id < 0

name: local_array_filter_limit
sr: SELECT id FROM {table} WHERE items[1] = 'abc' ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
pg: SELECT id FROM p WHERE items[1] = 'abc' ORDER BY id LIMIT 2

name: contains_string
sr: SELECT id FROM {table} WHERE array_contains(items, 'abc') ORDER BY id
pg: SELECT id FROM p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(items) u(v) WHERE v = 'abc') ORDER BY id

name: contains_null_element
sr: SELECT id FROM {table} WHERE array_contains(items, NULL) ORDER BY id
pg: SELECT id FROM p WHERE array_position(items, NULL) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id

name: group_null_empty_arrays
sr: SELECT array_map(x -> hex(x), items), COUNT(*) n FROM {table} WHERE id < 10 GROUP BY items ORDER BY array_length(items) NULLS FIRST
pg: SELECT CASE WHEN items IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE array_to_json(ARRAY(SELECT upper(encode(convert_to(v, 'UTF8'), 'hex')) FROM unnest(items) WITH ORDINALITY u(v,n) ORDER BY n))::text END, COUNT(*) n FROM p WHERE id < 10 GROUP BY items ORDER BY cardinality(items) NULLS FIRST
